window.title: XREDUX — XMM-Newton pulsar reduction
step.acquisition.description: Find the observation in the public XMM-Newton archive (XSA) and fetch its ODF, or point at an ODF you already have.
step.calibration.description: Builds the calibration index valid for the observation date (cifbuild) and ingests the ODF (odfingest). No other SAS task runs without these two products.
step.processing.description: Runs the official SAS chains that turn raw data into calibrated event lists: epproc, emproc, rgsproc and the OM chains.
step.filtering.description: Measures the high-energy background, discards soft-proton flares and produces the clean event list.
step.regions.description: Defines where source and background photons come from, and checks for pile-up, which distorts spectrum and light curve at once. Click the image to move the region; drag an edge to change a radius.
step.timing.description: Corrects arrival times to the Solar System barycentre and searches for periodicity — first by epoch folding, then refining with Z²ₙ on unbinned times.
step.spectra.description: Extracts photon counts per channel with this observation's own response (RMF and ARF), including phase-resolved slices.
step.export.description: Delivers the products in the form PULSARIS fits: a CSV event list and an instrument profile built from the real responses.
